name: meshix
description: Create, revise, and inspect 3D CAD models of physical parts with Meshix.

interface.longDescription: Create, revise, and inspect 3D CAD models of physical parts with Meshix. Describe a part and its dimensions, then generate or revise CAD, follow progress, and review 3D previews, CAD renders, and STL and STEP outputs. Find your designs, published gallery designs, and Community History. Sign in to Meshix to connect your account. Generation is asynchronous; generated artifacts do not guarantee physical fit or manufacturing safety. Assembly is a beta feature requiring explicit opt-in.
